title: Synthetic sepsis recognition and escalation workflow
text: Educational fixture only. When infection is suspected and a person shows new clinical deterioration, the workflow calls for prompt clinician review under the current approved local pathway. Record the observed change, vital-sign pattern, mental status, relevant symptoms, recent procedures or infections, available laboratory or imaging information, and the time concern was recognized. Communicate the concern using a structured handoff that identifies the person, states the suspected safety issue, summarizes supporting observations, and requests a clear response. Confirm who accepted responsibility and document unresolved concerns. This fixture intentionally omits diagnostic thresholds, treatment instructions, medication doses, and timing targets.

title: Synthetic critical-result communication workflow
text: Educational fixture only. A critical laboratory or imaging result requires closed-loop communication through the approved local process. Before communicating, verify the person, test, specimen or examination time, result, and reporting source. State the result exactly as reported without changing units or interpretation. Record the time sent, communication method, recipient, repeat-back or acknowledgement, and the next responsible clinician. If the intended recipient cannot be reached or does not acknowledge the message, follow the local escalation chain and document each attempt. This fixture does not define clinical thresholds or patient-specific actions.
